settings.muted.title: Muted accounts
settings.muted.count.one: {n} account — their posts are not shown, and not stored
settings.muted.count.other: {n} accounts — their posts are not shown, and not stored
settings.remote.title: Remote control
settings.remote.help: Exposes a JSON HTTP API (status, logs, launch a wapp) on port {port}, for development. Reachable only from this device, or a computer over adb.
settings.ble_debug.title: BLE debug logging
settings.ble_debug.help: Log BLE advertise/scan/broadcast activity to the app log
settings.reticulum.title: Reticulum
settings.reticulum.help: Bootstrap hubs the node connects to. It tries each in order until one answers with real Reticulum traffic.
settings.hosting.title: Hosting
settings.hosting.help: Host for the mesh: act as a NOSTR relay + file host so peers have a free place to store notes and files. Tiered fair-use quotas apply — your own and people you follow are kept; strangers are capped.
settings.hosting.enable.help: Store notes + files for other nodes (relay + Blossom)
settings.hosting.charging.help: Host only while charging on Wi-Fi/Ethernet (off = host on any connection)
settings.hosting.media.used: {gb} GB used — pictures from the people you follow. Their notes are never deleted.
settings.folders.title: Sharing folders
settings.folders.help: Signed Reticulum folders the app pulls from, peer-to-peer and verified by sha256. Each is an npub… (or hex folder id). Change these to follow a different publisher; leave blank for the built-in defaults.
settings.folders.edit_help: Reticulum address (npub… or hex folder id) of the signed folder the app pulls {channel} releases from. Binaries are fetched peer-to-peer and verified by sha256. Leave blank to reset to the built-in default.
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.storage.help: Where wapp settings, downloads, and user files are stored.
settings.storage.dir.help: Each wapp stores its settings and files in a subfolder here, named after the wapp ID.
settings.wappdata.title: Wapp Data
settings.wappdata.help: Each subfolder contains settings and files for one wapp.
settings.wappdata.none.help: Data folders are created when a wapp first runs.
settings.wappdata.delete.title: Delete {name}?
settings.wappdata.delete.body: This will permanently delete all settings and files for "{name}" ({size}).
settings.servers.title: Reticulum servers
settings.servers.help: Bootstrap hubs the node connects to, in priority order. It tries each from the top until one answers with real Reticulum traffic. Drag to reorder.
